bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- H2 FY26 Debt to Equity of 0.05 (down from 0.38 in FY22), and Debt Service Coverage Ratio improved to 3.57x in FY26 from 1.09x in FY23, indicating a largely deleveraged balance sheet.
- Net worth grew from ₹1,358 Lakh (FY22) to ₹12,300 Lakh (FY26); H2 FY26 ROE of 12.7% and ROCE of 16.9% (annualised).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: MICE: 273 programs (FY26); Corporate Travel: growing enterprise travel management platform; Leisure Travel: expanding B2C segment with launch of MachTravel.com
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Incorporated in 2004 as a MICE company, evolved into an integrated travel and mobility platform serving enterprise, institutional, government and retail travel requirements.
- PAN India presence with 400+ employees, 20+ years of experience and event management across 25+ countries; affiliated with IATA, IATO, PATA and ADTOI.
- Cites strong, established industry relationships with airlines and hotels as a strategic advantage enabling smoother deals and better negotiation terms, plus a long-standing corporate customer base supporting B2C cross-sell via brand recognition.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Rebranding] Company renamed from Mach Conferences and Events Limited to Mach Travel Solutions Limited in 2026, reflecting the pivot from MICE to an integrated travel platform.
- [Disruption] FY26 EBITDA and PAT margins improved despite temporary disruptions from Operation Sindoor and Middle East geopolitical developments, per the Chairman & Managing Director's letter.
- [Investor Relations] Adfactors Investor Relations (Vaibhav Gupta, Yash Sanghavi) acts as IR advisor alongside Company Secretary & Compliance Officer Yashashvi Srivastava.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin: 9.7% (FY26); PAT margin: 6.5% (FY26); Employee benefit expenses: ₹792 lakhs (H2 FY26); Other administrative expenses: ₹11,568 lakhs (H2 FY26)
